**Item #:** SCP-TEST-002

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-TEST-002 requires the following containment measures:

* A reinforced steel container with walls at least 5cm thick
* Temperature maintained between 15 and 20 degrees Celsius
* Weekly inspection by Level 2 personnel

Personnel entering the containment area must:

# Wear protective eyewear
# Maintain a distance of at least 2 meters
# Report any unusual behavior immediately

**Description:** SCP-TEST-002 is a metallic sphere approximately 15cm in diameter. The sphere exhibits //anomalous gravitational properties//[[footnote]]First documented in 1987 during initial containment.[[/footnote]], including:

* Periodic levitation up to 30cm above surfaces
* Attraction of small metallic objects within a 1-meter radius
* Emission of low-frequency vibrations detectable by specialized equipment

**Addendum TEST-002-A:** Recovery Log

SCP-TEST-002 was recovered from an abandoned warehouse in ████████, Ohio on ██/██/1987. Foundation agents were alerted after local reports of "floating metal balls" appeared in regional newspapers.

**Addendum TEST-002-B:** Incident Report

On ██/██/1995, SCP-TEST-002 exhibited previously unobserved behavior. The sphere began rotating rapidly and attracted all metallic objects within a 5-meter radius. The incident lasted approximately 3 minutes before the sphere returned to its dormant state.

No personnel were injured during this incident.
